name: The Times of India
tagline: India's Largest Circulated English Daily
description: The Times of India is India's most read and highest-circulated English newspaper, published by Bennett, Coleman & Co. Ltd. It commands dominant reach across tier-1 urban markets and corporate decision makers.
readershipProfile: Urban professionals, corporate leaders, affluent families, government officials and academic communities.
minimumBooking: 1 Insertion (Booking deadline 24 hours prior to printing)

name: The Hindu
tagline: India's National Newspaper Since 1878
description: The Hindu is renowned for authoritative, independent journalism, balanced reporting, and high credibility. It is the premier choice for institutional, public sector, and premium corporate campaigns.
readershipProfile: Civil service aspirants, legal and educational professionals, policy makers, senior executives, and intellectual households.

name: Hindustan Times
tagline: First Voice, Last Word
description: Hindustan Times is one of India's flagship English broadsheets with an unrivaled readership across Delhi-NCR and Northern India, known for sharp urban reportage and impactful supplements.
readershipProfile: Modern urban families, corporate managers, startup founders, and youth seeking contemporary lifestyle and business reporting.

name: The Economic Times
tagline: The World, Work & Wealth
description: The Economic Times is India's leading financial daily, providing comprehensive coverage of stock markets, macroeconomic policies, corporate mergers, fintech, and startups.
readershipProfile: C-suite executives, institutional investors, financial analysts, tech founders, and senior management.

name: Mint
tagline: Clarity in Business News
description: Mint, in collaboration with The Wall Street Journal, offers insightful business analysis, data-driven journalism, personal finance guidance, and policy breakdowns in Berliner format.
readershipProfile: Young finance professionals, tech leaders, venture capitalists, and corporate consultants.

name: Business Standard
tagline: When You're Sure
description: Business Standard is widely acclaimed for its rigorous editorial stance, thorough coverage of corporate governance, public finance, commodities, and industrial strategy.
readershipProfile: Senior bankers, industrial promoters, policy makers, economic consultants, and portfolio managers.

name: The Indian Express
tagline: Journalism of Courage
description: The Indian Express is celebrated for fearless investigative reporting, in-depth political discourse, legal insights, and deep-dive Explained series.
readershipProfile: Civil servants, judiciary, think-tank fellows, researchers, university faculties, and discerning urban citizens.

name: Dainik Jagran
tagline: India's Most Read Hindi Daily
description: Dainik Jagran has been India's largest read Hindi newspaper for over two decades according to the Indian Readership Survey, with unmatched penetration across UP, Bihar, Punjab, and Delhi-NCR.
readershipProfile: Hindi heartland households, local business traders, government personnel, and agricultural and retail entrepreneurs.

name: Dainik Bhaskar
tagline: Zid Karo, Duniya Badlo
description: Dainik Bhaskar is a flagship Hindi daily published by the DB Corp Group, leading the readership charts across Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, and Haryana.
readershipProfile: Tier 2 and Tier 3 aspirational consumer households, retail business owners, and youth seeking competitive exam information.

name: Amar Ujala
tagline: Josh Paida Karne Wala Sach
description: Amar Ujala delivers robust grassroots journalism across Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir, and Delhi-NCR.
readershipProfile: Middle-class families, rural entrepreneurs, school and college faculties, and regional FMCG consumers.

name: Malayala Manorama
tagline: Kerala's Morning Habit Since 1888
description: Malayala Manorama is the largest circulated Malayalam daily and one of India's most respected regional publications with profound reach among literate Malayali households and Gulf NRI families.
readershipProfile: Kerala households, NRI remitter families, doctors, educators, and high-saving consumers.

name: Daily Thanthi (Dina Thanthi)
tagline: The Voice of the Tamil People
description: Daily Thanthi is the highest circulated Tamil newspaper, read across urban and rural Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, and international Tamil diaspora.
readershipProfile: Tamil families, retail traders, cinema enthusiasts, agricultural communities, and youth.

name: Eenadu
tagline: Heartbeat of Telugu People
description: Eenadu, established by Ramoji Rao, is the undisputed leader in Telugu journalism across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, renowned for district editions and public interest campaigns.
readershipProfile: Telugu families, IT workers in Hyderabad, farmers, merchants, and state government employees.

name: Lokmat
tagline: Number One Daily of Maharashtra & Goa
description: Lokmat is the premier Marathi daily newspaper in Maharashtra and Goa, commanding unmatched readership across Mumbai, Pune, Nagpur, Aurangabad, and Nashik.
readershipProfile: Maharashtra urban and semi-urban households, industrial workforce, local entrepreneurs, and political leadership.

name: Anandabazar Patrika
tagline: The Unquestioned Heart of Bengali Intellectualism
description: Anandabazar Patrika (ABP Group) is the definitive Bengali daily newspaper, renowned for literary prose, deep investigative journalism, cultural authority, and commercial influence across Eastern India.
readershipProfile: Bengali families, academics, doctors, civil servants, writers, and cultural opinion shapers.

name: Gujarat Samachar
tagline: Voice of Gujarati Enterprise
description: Gujarat Samachar is Gujarat's most circulated Gujarati newspaper, widely read across Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Surat, Rajkot, and Mumbai's Gujarati trading community.
readershipProfile: Gujarati business owners, share market traders, diamond merchants, textile industrial houses, and NRI families.

name: Prajavani
tagline: Voice of the People of Karnataka
description: Prajavani is one of Karnataka's oldest and most respected Kannada dailies, published by The Printers (Mysore) Private Limited along with Deccan Herald.
readershipProfile: Kannada households, educators, civil servants, tech city residents, and regional business traders.

name: Punjab Kesari
tagline: Pioneering Daily of Punjab, Haryana & Delhi
description: Punjab Kesari is a widely circulated newspaper in Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, Himachal Pradesh, and Delhi, catering to urban and rural North Indian markets.
readershipProfile: Punjabi and Hindi business families, agrarian entrepreneurs, retailers, and youth exploring global migration and education.

name: Deccan Chronicle
tagline: The Leading English Daily of the Deccan
description: Deccan Chronicle is the largest circulated English daily in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, with substantial editions in Chennai, Bengaluru, and Kerala.
readershipProfile: Hyderabad IT professionals, college students, healthcare personnel, and urban retail shoppers.

name: The Telegraph
tagline: Unputdownable
description: The Telegraph (ABP Group) is the most widely circulated English daily in Eastern India, known for striking front-page headlines and deep coverage of the Northeast.
readershipProfile: Kolkata urban elite, corporate managers, university students, and intellectual households across Eastern India.

name: The Times of India - Delhi Times
tagline: Capital Lifestyle, Entertainment & City Culture Pullout
description: Delhi Times is the leading entertainment, lifestyle and glamour city supplement of The Times of India, capturing Delhi NCR high-net-worth consumer attention daily.
readershipProfile: Youth, affluent shoppers, urban families, lifestyle brand enthusiasts.

name: Hindustan Times - HT Brunch
tagline: India’s Premier Sunday Lifestyle Magazine Supplement
description: HT Brunch is the glossy Sunday lifestyle magazine accompanying Hindustan Times nationwide, featuring luxury, travel, food, and culture stories.
readershipProfile: Sunday morning leisure readers, luxury consumers, metro families.

name: The Economic Times - Brand Equity
tagline: The Bible of Indian Advertising, Marketing & Brand Strategy
description: ET Brand Equity is the essential weekly supplement of The Economic Times focused on media, advertising, marketing strategy, and brand showcases.
readershipProfile: CMOs, media planners, brand directors, marketing professionals.

name: The Hindu - MetroPlus
tagline: City Life, Food, Culture & Arts Daily Pullout
description: MetroPlus is The Hindu’s daily lifestyle and city culture supplement, capturing southern metro communities with insightful local reporting.
readershipProfile: South Indian metro residents, art enthusiasts, foodies and students.

name: Dainik Bhaskar - Rasrang
tagline: India’s Most Read Hindi Sunday Literature & Family Supplement
description: Rasrang is Dainik Bhaskar’s widely acclaimed Sunday literary and family supplement published across Rajasthan, MP, Haryana and Gujarat.
readershipProfile: Hindi-speaking families, cultural readers, tier-2 and tier-3 households.

name: Hindustan
tagline: Leading Hindi Daily of North India
description: Hindustan is one of the highest-read Hindi dailies across Northern India, published by HT Media. It delivers massive penetration in Delhi NCR, UP, Bihar, and Jharkhand.
readershipProfile: Hindi-speaking households, traders, local business owners, and regional consumers.
minimumBooking: 1 Insertion (Booking deadline 24 hours prior to printing)

name: Navbharat Times
tagline: Leading Hindi Daily of Metro Mumbai & Delhi
description: Navbharat Times is a prominent Hindi newspaper published by Bennett, Coleman & Co. Ltd. offering high-density coverage across affluent Hindi readers in Mumbai and Delhi.
readershipProfile: Urban Hindi readers, business owners, retail shoppers, and working professionals.

name: Rajasthan Patrika
tagline: Trustworthy Regional Voice of Western India
description: Rajasthan Patrika is renowned for independent and courageous journalism, commanding unparalleled loyalty across Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, and Gujarat.
readershipProfile: Regional business communities, families, and educated rural and urban readers.

name: Sakshi
tagline: Leading Telugu Daily of Telangana & Andhra Pradesh
description: Sakshi is a premier Telugu newspaper with comprehensive coverage throughout Telangana and Andhra Pradesh, popular for deep regional reporting and color clarity.
readershipProfile: Telugu-speaking households, political leaders, and retail consumers.
